name: Porto
tagline: Portugal's Riverside Gem for Affordable European Retirement
description: Porto offers everything Lisbon does for FIRE — the D7 visa, NHR tax benefits, and excellent healthcare — but at 15-20% lower costs with arguably more authentic Portuguese character. The Douro Valley at your doorstep, a UNESCO-listed city center, and a tight-knit expat community make it ideal for those who want substance over flash.

quickFacts.visa: D7 Passive Income Visa (same as Lisbon). NHR tax regime applies nationwide. Path to permanent residency and citizenship.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very Safe — low crime, walkable neighborhoods, strong community feel
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Francisco Sa Carneiro Airport (OPO) — 20 min from city center
quickFacts.climate: Oceanic with mild, rainy winters (8-14°C) and warm, dry summers (20-27°C). More rain than Lisbon.

housing.description: Room in a shared flat, Cedofeita / Bonfim / Campanhã

dining.description: Cooking at home from market produce with local spots a few times a week

healthcare.description: Minimum compliant D7 private policy, Portuguese insurer (Multicare/Médis)

entertainment.description: Free Douro riverfront walks, port-cellar tours, and Matosinhos beach days

1M.lifestyle: A budget-conscious Porto base — a room in a shared flat in a walkable neighborhood like Cedofeita, Bonfim, or Campanhã, away from the tourist core. Cooking at home from market produce with local spots a few times a week, moving on the Andante transit pass, and D7-compliant private cover carried. Porto runs cheaper than Lisbon, so this tier covers the basics comfortably with modest room to socialise.

dining.description: Dining out regularly with weekend seafood lunches in Matosinhos

healthcare.description: Mid-tier private plan, wider network (Médis Option 2)

entertainment.description: Casa da Música concerts, surf lessons, and Douro wine tours

2M.lifestyle: A renovated one-bedroom near the ocean in Foz or a stylish flat in the centre. Dining out regularly and weekend seafood lunches in Matosinhos, comprehensive private cover with dental, and a weekend rental car for the Douro Valley. Concerts at Casa da Música and an easy, enjoyable rhythm.

housing.description: 1BR in a good area, Foz edge / central / Boavista

dining.description: Regular meals at the city's best restaurants including tables like The Yeatman

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private plan, broad network, faster access (Médis Option 3)

entertainment.description: Private Douro cruises, golf at Estela, and gallery openings

3M.lifestyle: A one-bedroom in a good area — the Foz edge, central Porto, or Boavista. Regular dining at the city's best restaurants including tables like The Yeatman, a broad-network private plan, a leased car for frequent Douro trips, and regional flights a few times a year. Porto's lower costs make this a genuinely affluent daily life.

healthcare.description: Premium private cover or entry-level international plan

transportation.description: Add a luxury car and transfers, driver/helicopter at 10M

entertainment.description: Douro Valley experiences, premium club memberships, and arts patronage

5M.lifestyle: A premium, high-spec one-bedroom in the centre or in Foz do Douro. Regular dining at top restaurants, VIP private cover, regular household help, and a luxury car for Douro Valley drives. In a city this affordable, the budget delivers upper-affluent living with very few constraints.

housing.description: Luxury 1–2BR, Foz do Douro / central prime

dining.description: Private-chef dining and the finest tables in the north

transportation.description: Add a luxury car and transfers, driver/helicopter at 10M

entertainment.description: Boating, art patronage, and premium cultural-and-social life

10M.lifestyle: A luxury one-to-two-bedroom in Foz do Douro or at a landmark central address. Private-chef dining, top international health cover, a chauffeured car, full household help, and generous discretionary spend on Douro estates, boats, and travel. Porto has fewer ultra-premium services than Lisbon or larger capitals, so the budget covers everything here comfortably.
